## Cause

The `app` Deployment (namespace `default`) runs a pod with serviceAccount `config-reader`, and its initContainer `read-config` validates that it can reach the Kubernetes API:

```
curl --cacert ... --header "Authorization: Bearer $(cat .../token)"
  https://kubernetes.default.svc/api/v1/namespaces/default/configmaps/app-config >/dev/null
```

That request hit a **403 Forbidden** because the RBAC objects for `config-reader` simply did not exist — no `Role` and no `RoleBinding` were present in `default`, so the token was unauthenticated. The pod's init container crashed repeatedly:
- `Warning BackOff  (x9) spec.initContainers{read-config}: Back-off restarting failed container read-config`

The pre-existing `app-config-reader` / `app-reader` role and binding are from an older ReplicaSet; they bind to a different ServiceAccount and were left untouched.

## Change (smallest justified, least-privilege)

Created in namespace `default`:

```
Role/config-reader:  apiGroups=[""] resources=[configmaps] resourceNames=[app-config] verbs=[get]
RoleBinding/config-reader: subject SA config-reader -> role config-reader
```

Scope is intentionally narrowest: only ConfigMaps, only the one ConfigMap `app-config` used by the app, only namespace `default`, verb `get` alone. No cluster-wide permissions were added.

## Verified outcome (fresh observations)

- **Controller counts match:** Deployment `app` — `replicas=3 updated=3 ready=3 available=3 unavailable=(none)`; `rollout status` reported "successfully rolled out".
- **Pods healthy:** all three pods in the new ReplicaSet `app-dd8dcc57f` are `phase=Running ready=True restarts=0`; old crashing pod is gone.
- **No new errors:** `kubectl get events -n default | grep -i warn` shows only the 14m/4m-old BackOff event (before the fix), no warnings since.
- **Init container now succeeds instead of crashing.**
- **Read request actually works, not just the object status** — in-cluster call from each pod, authenticated with its own service-account token:
  ```
  GET /api/v1/namespaces/default/configmaps/app-config  → ConfigMap body {"data":{"message":"healthy"}}  (for bl2vt, kjs82, and rk652)
  ```
- **Least privilege preserved:** `role.config-reader.rules` = `[{"resourceNames":["app-config"],"resources":["configmaps"],"verbs":["get"]}]`; the only SA-bound bindings in `default` are the untouched `app-config-reader→app-reader` and the new `config-reader→config-reader`.
